name: river-range-v0
target: log10 E. coli per 100 ml; a result below the lab limit kept at the limit

features.lrain48: ln(1 + mm of rain in the 48 h before the sample)
features.lrain24: ln(1 + mm of rain in the 24 h before the sample)
features.logit_risk: logit of the lead-0 upstream exposure, as the bench builds it
features.doy_sin: sin of the day of year
features.doy_cos: cos of the day of year

range: likely reading 10^mu; 8 in 10 between 10^(mu - z*sd) and 10^(mu + z*sd), z = 1.2816
